School Knowledge Assistant · API-free mode

Info Chatbot · FAQ Admin

Yahan sawal aur jawab add karein. Save hone ke baad is browser mein chatbot unhein use karega.

Pehli dafa demo password: 2468. Login ke baad password change kar sakte hain. Yeh browser-only demo login hai, secure live authentication nahi.

📚 AI Knowledge Base — saari school information ek jagah

School ki information Urdu, Roman Urdu aur English mein yahan paste karein. Headings alag lines mein likhein (Admissions, Fees, Timings, Documents, Contact). Save karne ke baad chatbot is text mein relevant info dhoondhega. Ye offline matching mode hai; asli generative AI ke liye secure backend/API connect karna hoga.

Knowledge is saved in this browser only.

FAQs is device/browser ke local storage mein save hotay hain. Doosre devices ya live website par sync karne ke liye database/backend zaroori hai.
